analysis.summary: Alternate version of Sagittarius animation showing line-art-to-color transition. Features the same Art Nouveau centaur design transforming into photorealistic render. The auburn-haired archer centaur moves through an enchanted forest bathed in golden light, with vintage film sprocket overlay adding cinematic texture.

frames.text: Line art illustration of a Sagittarius centaur with decorative Art Nouveau border frame. The figure holds a bow with quiver on back, positioned in a detailed forest scene. Black and white coloring book style with intricate linework and a luminous halo.

Full-color rendered centaur in golden-lit forest. Auburn-haired young man in cream shirt and green vest merged with chestnut horse body. Film sprocket holes frame the image. Lush vegetation and dappled sunlight create magical atmosphere.

Photorealistic centaur in forest clearing, slightly turned pose showing profile. Warm golden lighting illuminates the scene. The character has a gentle, contemplative expression. Rich green foliage surrounds the figure.
